answer: An operator running 62 keys therefore pays for 62 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the horizon quota and the canyon admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the quartz ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 2 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
